answer.answer: By average “would definitely recommend” percentage, highest first; counts include all hospitals of each ownership type, including those without a recommend score: Government - Local: 11 hospitals, 79.0%, average rating 3.0; Government - State: 15, 79.0%, 3.67; Physician: 27, 78.85%, 3.67; Government - Hospital District or Authority: 78, 75.73%, 2.77; Voluntary non-profit - Other: 18, 74.36%, 3.43; Veterans Health Administration: 5, 74.2%, 4.4; Voluntary non-profit - Private: 134, 73.52%, 3.7; Voluntary non-profit - Church: 5, 73.5%, 3.75; Proprietary: 171, 68.58%, 3.01. answer.sql: SELECT h.hospital_ownership AS ownership_type, COUNT(*) AS texas_hospitals, ROUND(CAST(AVG(v.score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.overall_rating) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_overall_star_rating FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_tx_latest AS v ON v.facility_id = h.facility_id AND UPPER(v.measure_id) = UPPER('H_RECMND_DY') WHERE UPPER(h.state) = UPPER('TX') GROUP BY h.hospital_ownership HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

answer.sql: WITH hospital_periods AS (SELECT h.facility_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (mv.period_start, mv.period_end)) AS reporting_periods FROM hq.hospitals AS h JOIN hq.measure_values AS mv ON mv.facility_id = h.facility_id WHERE h.state = 'TX' AND UPPER(mv.measure_id) = UPPER('H_HSP_RATING_9_10') AND mv.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.facility_id) SELECT m.measure_id, m.measure_name, COUNT(hp.facility_id) AS texas_hospitals_with_score, MAX(hp.reporting_periods) AS largest_number_of_periods, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE hp.reporting_periods > 1) AS hospitals_with_multiple_periods FROM hospital_periods AS hp JOIN hq.measures AS m ON UPPER(m.measure_id) = UPPER('H_HSP_RATING_9_10') GROUP BY m.measure_id, m.measure_name LIMIT 200

s.mean_score) / NULLIF(s.sd_score, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) ELSE ROUND(CAST(((r.score - s.mean_score) / NULLIF(s.sd_score, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) END AS z_score FROM raw AS r JOIN stats AS s USING (measure_id)), hospital_scores AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, MAX(z_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'READM_30_PN') AS readmission_z, MAX(z_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY') AS recommend_z, MAX(z_score) FILTER(WHERE measure_id = 'SEP_1') AS sepsis_care_z FROM z_scores GROUP BY facility_id, facility_name, county HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT measure_id) = 3), composites AS (SELECT facility_id, facility_name, county, readmission_z, recommend_z, sepsis_care_z, ROUND(CAST(((readmission_z + recommend_z + sepsis_care_z) / 3) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS composite_score FROM hospital_scores), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score DESC, facility_name, county) AS high_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score ASC, facility_name, county) AS low_rank FROM composites), selected AS (SELECT 1 AS group_order, high_rank AS group_rank, * FROM ranked WHERE high_rank <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS group_order, low_rank AS group_rank, * FROM ranked WHERE low_rank <= 10) SELECT CASE WHEN group_order = 1 THEN 'Highest' ELSE 'Lowest' END AS group_name, facility_name AS hospital_name, county, composite_score, readmission_z, recommend_z, sepsis_care_z, 'READM_30_PN' AS readmission_measure_id, 'Pneumonia 30-Day Readmission Rate (sign flipped)' AS readmission_measure_name, 'H_RECMND_DY' AS recommend_measure_id, 'Would definitely recommend the hospital' AS recommend_measure_name, 'SEP_1' AS sepsis_measure_id, 'Appropriate care for severe sepsis and septic shock' AS sepsis_measure_name FROM selected ORDER BY group_order, group_rank, facility_name, county LIMIT 200

answer.sql: WITH selected_measures AS (SELECT measure_id, measure_name, higher_is_better FROM hq.measures WHERE UPPER(measure_id) IN ('READM_30_PN', 'MORT_30_HF', 'HAI_1_SIR', 'SEP_1', 'H_RECMND_DY', 'H_STAR_RATING')), latest_scored AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (mv.facility_id, UPPER(mv.measure_id)) mv.facility_id, UPPER(mv.measure_id) AS measure_id, mv.score FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN selected_measures AS sm ON UPPER(sm.measure_id) = UPPER(mv.measure_id) WHERE mv.score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mv.facility_id, UPPER(mv.measure_id), mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST), national AS (SELECT sm.measure_id, sm.measure_name, sm.higher_is_better, AVG(ls.score) AS national_average FROM selected_measures AS sm JOIN latest_scored AS ls ON ls.measure_id = UPPER(sm.measure_id) JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = ls.facility_id GROUP BY sm.measure_id, sm.measure_name, sm.higher_is_better), texas_stats AS (SELECT n.measure_id, COUNT(*) AS texas_hospitals_with_score, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (n.higher_is_better AND ls.score > n.national_average) OR (NOT n.higher_is_better AND ls.score < n.national_average)) AS texas_hospitals_beating_national FROM national AS n JOIN latest_scored AS ls ON ls.measure_id = UPPER(n.measure_id) JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = ls.facility_id WHERE UPPER(h.state) = UPPER('TX') GROUP BY n.measure_id) SELECT n.measure_id, n.measure_name, ROUND(CAST(n.national_average AS DECIMAL), 2) AS national_average, t.texas_hospitals_with_score, t.texas_hospitals_beating_national, ROUND(100.0 * t.texas_hospitals_beating_national / NULLIF(t.texas_hospitals_with_score, 0), 1) AS texas_share_beating_pct FROM national AS n JOIN texas_stats AS t ON t.measure_id = n.measure_id ORDER BY texas_share_beating_pct DESC, n.measure_id LIMIT 200
